Personality.intro: We've crunched the numbers. Your <personality>viewing personality</personality> is…

nightOwl.name: The Night Owl
nightOwl.description: When everyone else turns in, your screen lights up. The best episodes start after dark.

earlyBird.name: The Early Bird
earlyBird.description: You press play before the kettle's even boiled. Who needs breakfast TV?

weekendWarrior.name: The Weekend Warrior
weekendWarrior.description: Weekdays are for work. Saturdays and Sundays belong to the sofa.

binger.name: The Binger
binger.description: ‘Just one more episode’ isn't a promise. It's a way of life.

marathoner.name: The Marathoner
marathoner.description: Day after day after day, you kept the streak alive.

completionist.name: The Completionist
completionist.description: You start it, you finish it. No movie left behind.

explorer.name: The Explorer
explorer.description: New shows, new sounds, new worlds. Your watchlist needs a passport.

timeTraveller.name: The Time Traveller
timeTraveller.description: Why live in the present when the classics are right there?

loyalist.name: The Loyalist
loyalist.description: When you find something you love, you stick with it. Again and again.

cinephile.name: The Cinephile
cinephile.description: Lights down, phone away. For you, movies come first and everything else comes second.

seriesDevotee.name: The Series Devotee
seriesDevotee.description: Cliffhangers, story arcs and season finales: you're in it for the long haul.

musicLover.name: The Music Lover
musicLover.description: Your server is your record collection, and the volume's always up.

freeSpirit.name: The Free Spirit
freeSpirit.description: No rules, no routine. You watch whatever you like, whenever you like, and that's the beauty of it.
